speed_eligibility.costs: CLI load/startup + decoding + timestamp serialization/offsets + VAD/extraction + TXT/SRT writing

selection: lowest aggregate reference WER among complete eligible configurations; provisional outside reference domain

fallback.when: fewer than two additional models produce an evaluable complete pass (early disqualification counts as evaluated)

early_stop_amendment: User requested stopping conclusively ineligible candidates: stop after the fixed quality pass fails thresholds, or two corpus timings prove a three-pass median cannot meet the ceiling. Three passes remain required for eligible candidates.
